sections.heading: Toddler Swimwear Sizes 2T–4T for Active Play
sections.body:
From 2T to 4T, toddlers crawl, sit and climb around in wet suits. We line the front and seat to cope with that friction, and a 3-snap crotch or a front or back entry zip makes changes and toilet trips at the pool quicker.

Choose the standard chart below or send your own before the first sample; we cut and grade to whichever sizing your labels carry.

| Size | Age | Height | Weight |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2T | About 2 years | 88 to 94 cm | 12 to 14 kg |
| 3T | About 3 years | 94 to 100 cm | 14 to 16 kg |
| 4T | About 4 years | 100 to 106 cm | 16 to 18 kg |

sections.heading: Tween and Teen Swimwear Sizes and Shaped Fits
sections.body: For tween and young teen styles that need room at the bust, waist and hips, choose a shaped teen fit instead of our proportional children's grading.

items.title: Sizes by age or height
items.text: Order tween and young teen sizes by age, from 8-10 to 12-14, or by height up to 164 cm, the chart we recommend for European markets.

items.title: A separate teen block
items.text: Each shaped style is drafted on its own teen block, allowing for a developing bust, a defined waist, fuller hips and a longer torso.

items.title: Graded area by area
items.text: We grade the bust, waist and hips separately, so proportions, coverage, support and tension stay right from the smallest teen size to the largest.

items.title: Fit checked in movement
items.text: As well as checking fit standing, we check every teen sample in movement, where riding up and gaping show.

items.title: Support for older sizes
items.text: Sewn-in or removable foam padding and cup pockets suit teen tops and one-pieces, while underwire channels and moulded cups go only into the older sizes.

qa.question: Can you make separate fits for toddlers in swim nappies and for toilet-trained toddlers?
qa.answer: Yes, we cut separate patterns. The swim-nappy fit adds 2 to 3 cm to the standard seat and rise and widens the leg openings, while the toilet-trained fit keeps the standard seat, rise and leg openings. We sample both for your approval before bulk, because a nappy layer added to a standard pattern changes the fit and the suit leaks or pulls.

qa.question: Can you make tween and teen bikinis and tankinis with more coverage?
qa.answer: Yes. We make tankinis with more coverage, including cross-strap tops with swim shorts, as well as age-appropriate bikinis. Tops come high-neck or as sporty crops, and bottoms come full-coverage or mid-rise, or as swim shorts or skirted bottoms.
